_note: Agent registry for hub-acp.mjs. Every entry is an ACP *Agent* (a subprocess the hub drives as Client); Zed is not here because it is an ACP Client, not an Agent. The hub itself orchestrates -- router.mjs and fanout-acp.mjs decide what runs where; no agent in this file decomposes tasks. Commands are per-platform: on Windows the hub runs OpenCode natively (`opencode.cmd acp`).

opencode.label: OpenCode
opencode.notes: OpenCode runs natively on Windows (opencode.cmd acp); if you run it in WSL instead, point the command at your own install, because opencode is usually not on the non-interactive WSL PATH. The PAID OpenCode Go DeepSeek (opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash) is the default and comes before the free one: the free variant is now the first fallback, so the hub only reaches it when the paid pool reports exhaustion, and the same weights cost nothing there. Order after that: claude-haiku-5-5, mimo-v2.5, then beam-free as last resort. modelFallbacks is walked by router.mjs and the MCP ask path; an explicit --model is never substituted. Allowed set otherwise unchanged (the latest DeepSeek either namespace, opencode/gpt-6-luna, minimax-m3, opencode-go/muse-spark-1.2-contributor, any -free-suffixed model). Prices per million tokens, input/output (opencode models, 2026-11-03): deepseek-v4.1-flash 0.15/0.60 (best agentic score in the catalog), claude-haiku-5-5 0.10/0.50, mimo-v2.5 0.14/0.28, beam-free 0/0.

claude.label: Claude Agent (ACP adapter)
claude.notes: Claude Code itself is not an ACP server; the first-party adapter wraps the Claude Agent SDK. Needs Claude credentials in the same environment that runs this entry, which in practice means the hub must run on Windows: the credentials live in %USERPROFILE%\.claude, and the WSL-side `npx` adapter fails with `session/prompt: Authentication required (code -32000)`. The adapter exposes these model values: default (Sonnet 5), sonnet (Sonnet 5.5), haiku (Haiku 5.5), opus (Opus 5.5), fable (Fable 5.1). Use --model haiku for cheap runs and --model sonnet for coding; the plan's weekly limit still applies.

codex.label: Codex (ACP adapter)
codex.notes: Adaptador mantenido; pin exacto. Habla ACP v1/v2 y arranca Codex App Server (depende de @openai/codex ^0.166.0; CLI local 0.167.0). Usa la auth ChatGPT existente; nunca pasar ni imprimir tokens. Sustituye a @zed-industries/codex-acp@0.16.0 (deprecado: embebe Codex 0.137 y falla con -32603 en modelos 6.x). Modelos (models_cache.json, 2026-11-08): gpt-6.1-terra defecto, gpt-6.1-sol escalado, gpt-6-luna lote; gpt-6-astra solo con --model explícito.
